author: Elvirah
content: Everybody has dreams, but not all would be faithful to their dreams. They try to stick to their dreams for a while and if something goes wrong in between, they think thats not the right one for them. But its great to know that you have not only dreamt but also accomplished your fantasy. Very few would have the courage to dream of a B-school and its indeed appreciable that you lived yours without giving it up.
